title: Project Management — 15-week course map (SKY GATEWAY HYDERABAD)
derivedFrom: mission brief §5.2/§6 — replace with the official outline

clos.text: Understand and apply project-management concepts, life cycles, delivery approaches and frameworks (PMBOK 8 principles, performance domains and focus areas) to a real-world-scale project.
Apply quantitative tools and techniques — CPM/PERT, EVM, Monte Carlo, EMV, control charts — to plan, monitor and control scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk.
Manage people, stakeholders, communication and procurement ethically and effectively in a multi-stakeholder public infrastructure context.

objectives.text: Explain what makes work a project and how projects, programmes, portfolios and operations relate within an organisation.
Select and tailor a life cycle and delivery approach (predictive, Agile, hybrid) for a complex infrastructure programme.
Build and baseline integrated scope, schedule and cost plans, and analyse them quantitatively.
Monitor and control performance, quality, change and risk using data, and forecast outcomes.
features: control, quality, risk and forecast panels

objectives.text: Lead teams, engage stakeholders, communicate and procure ethically through to handover and closure.
features: team, stakeholders, procurement and closing panels

weeks.topic: Project management foundations: project vs operations, programme, portfolio, PMO, EEFs and OPAs, frameworks
weeks.mechanic: Site walk (mode 1) of the closed terminal and runway; classify findings as EEFs or OPAs; read the charter

weeks.topic: Project life cycle, process groups and PMBOK 8 focus areas, principles and performance domains
weeks.mechanic: Approve stage gates G0/G1 and watch the phase indicator move through the focus areas

weeks.topic: Delivery approaches: predictive, Agile, hybrid; Scrum and Kanban; AI in project management
weeks.mechanic: Run Scrum sprints for terminal IT (WBS 10) on the board (B); ask MEHRAN to draft backlog items and review them

weeks.topic: Scope management: requirements, scope statement, WBS and WBS dictionary, validate and control scope
weeks.mechanic: Explore the 12-package WBS in 3D (click to select), trace requirements, resist scope-creep cards

weeks.topic: Schedule management: CPM, PERT, crashing and fast-tracking (British Columbia Transportation case)
weeks.mechanic: Find the critical path, crash by cost slope, and keep SPI ≥ 0.95 through the earthworks

weeks.topic: Monitoring and controlling, integrated change control, closing a phase
weeks.mechanic: Raise and decide change requests at the CCB (C); review variance thresholds and phase-gate closure

weeks.topic: Quality management: cost of quality, control charts, Pareto, root cause, NCRs
weeks.mechanic: Pass the pavement quality gate with zero open NCRs; react to dust-storm and cube-failure cards
Mid-term practice quiz drawn from weeks 1–7; mission review and scorecard snapshot

weeks.topic: Cost management: estimating, budgeting, reserves, earned value and forecasting
weeks.mechanic: Track PV/EV/AC, EAC and TCPI; absorb a PKR devaluation through reserves or hedging

weeks.topic: Risk management: identification, qualitative and quantitative analysis, responses (AstraZeneca pandemic case)
weeks.mechanic: Size reserves with EMV and Monte Carlo; survive the monsoon flash flood with the drainage complete

weeks.topic: Procurement management: make-or-buy, contract types, weighted bid evaluation, claims and ethics
weeks.mechanic: Evaluate bids with weighted scoring, award packages, handle a vendor bribe attempt and a cash-flow crisis
Clear the encroachment without losing the community; heat-wave and union cards; tailor the communications plan

weeks.topic: MS Project workshop: tasks, links, lags, resources, baselines and tracking
weeks.mechanic: Export the schedule as MSPDI XML / CSV, rebuild it in MS Project and compare the critical path

weeks.topic: Project presentations (I): status reporting and storytelling with data
weeks.mechanic: Presentation mode (R): build a status report from live data and present a tour segment

weeks.topic: Project presentations (II), closing the project and final review
weeks.mechanic: Hand over to operations, log lessons learned, print the scorecard certificate; final review quiz
